bandReport.notes: Single-column scan read from whole-page images (no column crops). aglasem.com watermark ignored. All 75 items are 4-option MCQs; no NOT_MCQ items. Irregular printed option letters: Q20 option (a) printed as 'a)'; Q21 fourth option printed as '(b) Robert Peary' (stored as D); Q63 options printed in the order (a) water, (c) vacuum, (b) Vacuum, (d) grass - stored in printed order A-D, so B = 'vacuum' (printed (c)) and C = 'Vacuum' (printed (b)). Q63 is defective as printed: 'vacuum' appears twice (the Hindi of the first reads 'hawa' = air) and 'grass' (Hindi 'sheesha' = glass); flagged DEFECTIVE. Verbatim oddities kept: Q37 'on______it?', Q38 'UPI'', Q39 'fora,', Q41 stray opening quote in 'Gully Boy, Q58 'Academy!', Q64 option D ends 'from', Q65 option A 'Lie wire' (likely 'Live'), Q27 'Kerla', Q28 'Governer' / 'identity'.
